title: Count the basket items as numbers
summary: The basket page joined its two quantities as text, so 2 and 3 showed as 23 items. basketCount now turns both values into numbers before it adds them.

scenes.title: The mission

narration.text: The basket page counted its items wrongly. This change fixes the count.

visual.heading: Count the basket items as numbers

scenes.visualDescription: Title card with the name of the fix.

scenes.title: The steps that show the bug

narration.text: In the reproduction, someone opens the basket page.
Then they type 2 for the trail mix and 3 for the oat bars.
The reproduction shows the page saying 23 items. That is the bug.

scenes.visualDescription: The steps of the reproduction, with the page that says 23 items.

scenes.title: The bug on the page

narration.text: This is the bug, on the basket page. Someone types 2 trail mix and 3 oat bars.
The page then says 23 items, not 5.

scenes.visualDescription: The recorded basket page before the fix: the count reads 23 items.

scenes.title: The cause in basketCount

narration.text: The cause is in basketCount. The quantity fields give text, so the plus sign joined the two values.
The fix turns both values into numbers with Number, before it adds them.

focus.note: Number turns text into a number

scenes.visualDescription: The changed line of basketCount, with the old and the new return.

scenes.title: The page after the fix

narration.text: After the fix, the same steps give the right answer. Someone types 2 trail mix and 3 oat bars.

scenes.visualDescription: The recorded basket page after the fix: the count reads 5 items.

scenes.title: Before and after

narration.text: Side by side, the same two quantities. Before the fix the count reads 23 items. After it, the count reads 5 items.

scenes.visualDescription: Two screenshots of the basket page: the count before and after the fix.

scenes.title: What to check

narration.text: The notes ask for one check. Number also accepts values such as 1e2, and the page does not block them.
The coding agent reported that npm test passed.

items.title: Values such as 1e2
items.detail: Number accepts them and the page does not block them.

scenes.visualDescription: One review point about the values that Number accepts.

scenes.title: Wrap up

narration.text: In short, basketCount now adds numbers, not text. Two and three give five.

points.text: basketCount turns both quantities into numbers
A new test file covers text quantities

scenes.visualDescription: A short list of what changed.

uncertainties: The captures show the page in one browser window. The change does not show other browsers.
